items.reason: Gap 0 describes two copies of one event running at once, both passing the set check before either inserts, so it is processed twice.
Gap 2 says the key is copied from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that a forged or altered header can bypass or suppress de-duplication.
Gap 3 says refunds arrive as charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas; gap 0 concerns concurrent jobs within one queue.
